en.hubeali:
From him, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ziyad Bin Marwan Al Qindy, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who eats seven Ajwa dates at his sleep time, would kill the insects in his belly’.
en.sarwar: 20. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ya’qub ibn from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qandiy from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Eating seven dates of al-‘Ajwah at bed time kill the worms in one’s belly.”’
